business: Turbolux Home Finish: a fixed-price 2BHK paint + painter package from Turbolux Paints, Kochi pilot
target: Kochi homeowners with a 2BHK flat or house that is due for a repaint after the monsoon (all money in this brief is in Indian rupees: read every $ as ₹)

behaviours.name: Uses the family's painter
behaviours.how: Calls the same local painter the family has used for years and buys whatever paint he suggests.

behaviours.name: Three quotes and haggles
behaviours.how: Gets at least three quotes, compares per-square-foot rates and bargains hard.

behaviours.name: Zero-hassle
behaviours.how: Busy with work and family; pays more to not manage workers, materials and dates.

behaviours.name: Brand-loyal
behaviours.how: Trusts only the paint brands they see on TV and asks for them by name.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks Google ratings, asks neighbours and WhatsApp groups before hiring anyone.

behaviours.name: Managing from abroad
behaviours.how: Owner works in the Gulf; parents or a relative live in the house and have to supervise any work.

behaviours.name: Waits until it is bad
behaviours.how: Puts off repainting until damp patches, peeling or an upcoming function forces it.

objections: ₹78,000 is much more than our local painter would charge
I have not heard much about Turbolux; is it as good as the big brands?
Crews from these painting services stop turning up halfway; will this one really finish on the date?
Will they send some subcontractor and then stop answering when there is a problem?
Will the final bill be more than the quoted price once they see the walls?
What exactly does the guarantee cover, and for how long?
Our painter is someone we know; I don't want strangers in the house
I only need some walls done, not the whole house
habits: you live in a flat in Kakkanad and the building has strict working hours for contractors
you have an independent house in Edappally with damp patches on the outside walls
a family wedding is coming up in a few months and relatives will visit
you last repainted about six years ago
your elderly parents live in the house while you work in Dubai
you saw paint bubbling on one bedroom wall after this monsoon
